name: Shinigami
subtitle: Shadow Reaper
description: Bring your foes to the afterlife as you Curse and Drain their lifeforce.
lore: Terrifying kami of Izumo, the shinigami are considered spirits by some, gods by others. As literal manifestations of the death urge, shinigami call mortals to the underworld of Yomi. Some are content merely guiding those who seek death—whether self-inflicted or in the pursuit of some cause—but others possess the living and influence their victims to take their own lives.
divinity_generator: Gain [80] Divinity when an enemy is defeated.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Attunement Multiplier +5%, Armor Multiplier +2.5%, Weapon Multiplier +2.5%
Attunement Multiplier +5%, Armor Multiplier +2.5%, Weapon Multiplier +2.5%

skills.name: Soul Cleave
skills.description: Attack all enemies 2 times. Each hit has a 50% chance to place [mechanic:def-down-i] on each target for 2 turns.

skills.name: Mortal Reminder
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 2 times. Each hit has a 40% chance to destroy MAX HP by 5% of the damage inflicted.
skills.awakening_bonus: Also has a 40% chance to steal 1 random [Buff], will always steal [Phoenix].

skills.name: Custodial Reaper
skills.description:
Attack 1 enemy with a 75% chance to place [mechanic:curse-i] and [mechanic:drain-i] on the target for 2 turns.

Increases the damage inflicted by 3% for each [Debuff] on the target.

skills.name: Afterlife Calls
skills.description: Instantly defeat an enemy if they have less than 10% HP after attacking them.

imprint_passive: Instantly defeat an enemy if they have less than 5% HP after attacking them.
